observations.body: The ordinances forbid false report, malicious witness, crowd distortion, partiality, neglect of an enemy’s animal, denial of poor people’s justice, bribery, and oppression of foreigners.
observations.label: Truth and justice resist crowd, poverty, hatred, and oppression

observations.body: The ordinances follow the Ten Words and apply them through concrete cases, but they are not identical to the Decalogue.

payload.posture: Read Exodus 23:1–9 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Truth and justice resist crowd, poverty, hatred, and oppression belongs to the covenant ordinances movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
